title: Generalized cross product of an (m+1)-dimensional subspace A₀ (the volume form of A₀, parent step 2)
statement: Cross product in A₀. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P with dim A₀ = m + 1. Conclusion: there is a continuous alternating m-linear map N : (ℝ^P)^m → ℝ^P (an element of Euclid P [⋀^Fin m]→L[ℝ] Euclid P) such that for every w = (w_1, …, w_m) ∈ (ℝ^P)^m: (i) N(w) ∈ A₀; (ii) N(w)·w_j = 0 for every j; (iii) if (w_j) is orthonormal and every w_j ∈ A₀, then |N(w)| = 1; (iv) if (w_j) is linearly independent and every w_j ∈ A₀, then N(w) ≠ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → ∃ N : Euclid P [⋀^Fin m]→L[ℝ] Euclid P, (∀ w : Fin m → Euclid P, N w ∈ A₀) ∧ (∀ (w : Fin m → Euclid P) (j : Fin m), inner ℝ (N w) (w j) = 0) ∧ (∀ w : Fin m → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ w → (∀ j, w j ∈ A₀) → ‖N w‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ w : Fin m → Euclid P, LinearIndependent ℝ w → (∀ j, w j ∈ A₀) → N w ≠ 0
